description: A very thin day: two items. No digest is expected.

items.title: Calder Health appoints a new data chief
items.extract: Calder Health has appointed a new chief data officer.
items.article_text: Calder Health has appointed a new chief data officer. The appointment takes effect on the first of next month. The health system did not give further details.

items.title: Quillon AI announces a developer event
items.extract: Quillon AI announced a developer event for next spring.
items.article_text: Quillon AI announced a developer event for next spring. The company said sessions will cover its model and tools. Dates and a venue have not been set.
